# Amos Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 335r–335v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/AMO_002_page_001.jpg

---

**2:1** Thus says YHWH: "For three transgressions [pish'ei] of-Mo'av [Moab], and-for four, I-will-not turn-it-back — because he-burned [sorfo] the-bones [atsmot] of-the-king of-Edom to-lime [la-sid]."

**2:2** "And-I-will-send fire on-Mo'av, and-it-will-devour the-fortresses of-Qeriyyot [Kerioth]; and-Mo'av will-die [umet] in-tumult [be-sha'on], with-shouting [bi-teru'ah], with-the-sound of-the-trumpet [shofar]."

**2:3** "And-I-will-cut-off [vehikhrati] the-judge [shofet] from-her-midst [mi-qirbah], and-all her-princes I-will-kill [eherog] with-him," says YHWH.

**2:4** Thus says YHWH: "For three transgressions of-Yehudah, and-for four, I-will-not turn-it-back — because they-rejected [mo'osam] the-torah [torat] of-YHWH, and-his-statutes [chuqqav] they-did-not keep [lo shamaru], and-their-lies [khazvehem] led-them-astray [vayyat'um] after-which their-fathers walked [halkhu]."

**2:5** "And-I-will-send fire on-Yehudah, and-it-will-devour the-fortresses of-Yerushalayim."

**2:6** Thus says YHWH: "For three transgressions of-Yisra'el, and-for four, I-will-not turn-it-back — because they-sold [mokhram] the-righteous [tsaddiq] for-silver [ba-kesef], and-the-needy [evyon] for-a-pair of-sandals [na'alayim]."

**2:7** "Those-who-trample [ha-sho'afim] on-the-dust [afar] of-the-earth [erets] on-the-head [rosh] of-the-poor [dallim], and-the-way [derekh] of-the-humble [anavim] they-turn-aside [yattu]; and-a-man [ish] and-his-father [aviv] go [yelkhu] to the-same girl [ha-na'arah], in-order-to profane [chalel] my-holy [qodshi] name [shem]."

**2:8** "And-on garments [begadim] taken-in-pledge [chavulim] they-stretch-out [yattu] beside every altar [mizbe'ach]; and-the-wine [veyein] of-the-fined [anushim] they-drink [yishtu] in-the-house of-their-god [elohehem]."

**2:9** "And-I destroyed [hishmadeti] the-Amorite [ha-Emori] from-before-them [mi-peneihem], whose height [govho] [was] like-the-height of-cedars [arazim] and-strong [chason] he [was] like-the-oaks [allonim]; and-I-destroyed his-fruit [piryo] from-above [mi-ma'al] and-his-roots [shorashav] from-below [mi-tachat]."

**2:10** "And-I brought-you-up [he'eleiti] from-the-land of-Mitsrayim [Egypt], and-led-you [va'olekh] in-the-wilderness [ba-midbar] forty [arba'im] years [shanah], to-possess [lareshet] the-land of-the-Amorite."

**2:11** "And-I-raised-up [va'aqim] from-your-sons [mi-beneikhem] for-prophets [li-nevi'im], and-from-your-young-men [mi-bachureikhem] for-Nazirites [li-nezirim]. Is-it-not indeed [af] so, O-sons of-Yisra'el?" declares YHWH.

**2:12** "But-you-made-drink [vatashqu] the-Nazirites wine [yayin], and-the-prophets you-commanded [tsivvitem], saying, 'Do-not prophesy [lo tinnave'u].'"

**2:13** "Behold, I [am] pressing-down [me'iq] under-you [tachteikhem] as the-cart [ha-agalah] presses-down [ta'iq] [when] full [male'ah] of-sheaves [amir]."

**2:14** "And-flight [manos] will-perish from-the-swift [mi-qal], and-the-strong [chazaq] will-not strengthen [lo yeammets] his-power [kocho], and-the-warrior [gibbor] will-not save [lo yemaltet] his-life [nafsho]."

**2:15** "And-the-one-who-handles [tofes] the-bow [qeshet] will-not stand [lo ya'amod]; and-the-swift [qal] of-foot [be-raglav] will-not escape [lo yemaltet]; and-the-rider [rokhev] of-the-horse [ha-sus] will-not save his-life."

**2:16** "And-the-stout [ammits] of-heart [libbo] among-the-warriors [ba-gibborim] — naked [arom] he-will-flee [yanus] in-that day [ba-yom ha-hu]," declares YHWH.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.6 — "sold the righteous for silver":** The pivot of the book — after six foreign nations and Judah, Israel finally stands accused. The charges are social, not cultic: selling people for debts (literally for the price of sandals), exploitation of the poor.

**v.7 — "a man and his father go to the same girl":** Whether this refers to cultic prostitution or exploitation of a servant-girl is debated. The phrase *lechalel et-shem qodshi* ("to profane my holy name") suggests religious violation through social injustice.

**v.13 — "I am pressing down under you":** The image is of a cart overloaded with grain sheaves — it sinks, crushes. YHWH will press down on Israel with the weight of their own sin.

*— EMET*
